description: This Java class defines a command for retrieving the definition of a 'Thing' by its ID within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and specifies resource paths and supported schema versions.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinition
classes.description: Final class representing a command to retrieve a Thing's definition by its ID, immutable, supports JSON serialization/deserialization, and implements necessary interfaces for the framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new RetrieveThingDefinition command instance with specified ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveThingDefinition command instance from a JSON string or object, parsing the Thing ID and headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing whose definition is requested.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource ('/definition').

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated headers.
